result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-structured. The one clear visual defect is that the Smash Bros Burgers card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel sits about 28px lower than its neighbours, so its image and title don't line up with the rest of the row. The clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and are not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card is vertically offset by roughly 28px. Its image top (about y=659) and title (about y=828) don't align with Green Bowl Poké (image top about y=631, title about y=800) or Trattoria Piccola, so the row looks misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top edge by fixing the card container's vertical offset or margin, and make sure every card uses the same image height and text block structure.
